title: JA Kinetic wp7: author, Features rows, 390 overflow, mega panels, tablet header and drawer, footer links, eyebrow tags, leftovers, timeline and 404 band behave like the source
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-kinetic theme under test (local stand from the quickstart/ja-kinetic/wp7 pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-kinetic/j6).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/tools/measure115.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --out <dir> (add --zip <theme.zip> --record <BROWSER.json> to bind the run to the theme bytes).
S3: Read the last line and each PASS/FAIL line.
expect: author, features, overflow, mega, tablet, footer, eyebrow, comments, timeline404: each PASS with a non-zero examined count.
evidence: Independent audit 03/10/2026; measure115 on 1.1.4 vs 1.1.5 (tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/release/measure115-before-1.1.4.json, measure115-after-1.1.5.json); 9/9 on 1.1.5 bound to the theme zip (tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/release/BROWSER.json)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the tool fails closed on a crash
